minimum_samples_reason: Four finite-difference intervals, not a claim of sufficient behavioral evidence. Inputs below one second are retained and flagged separately.
selection: Within the human-confirmed intervals for five reviewed clips and previously image-verified intervals for eight others: longest supported duration up to 2.5s; among equal-duration candidates choose nearest mean camera distance. Never consult GPS or class predictions.
image_identity: Human anchors dominate. Flow only to adjacent anchors or the reviewed bounds; conflicting image votes are not used as 3D support. Do not infer depth from a 2D box.
reconstruction: Existing BEV checkpoint and camera calibration; native-time jump rejection and RTS smoothing unchanged. No extrapolation, no independent ego/leader alignment, no newly fitted GPS offsets.
public_initialization: Existing 3-second public fold0 checkpoints, seeds 42/52/62. Reuse exactly their source-disjoint partition. All weights trainable; retain positional embedding shape and use only real 0.1s positions.
public_augmentation: Ten variants per source window: five leader-availability patterns at 26 points, plus the same five patterns at a shared randomly selected length 5..25. Crop before computing derivatives. Missing leader values and padded time are masked separately. Variant generation and sampling are independent of class.
field_split: Leave one eligible video out; one AV and one HV validation video; others train. All variants of a video remain in the same split. Three seeds averaged, threshold fixed at 0.5. Same camera/vehicle and potentially sessions recur: development estimate only.
normalization: Preserve each public initialization's source-training statistics. Never fit normalization on Todd validation or test videos.
reporting: One selected window and one out-of-fold prediction per eligible video. Report actual length, short-input flag, GPS coverage and source-only versus adapted results. Earlier 3-second results are shown on common videos with changed-data confounding stated. No new detector training in this run.
